source_clauses.verbatim: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
Pressing it should send a signal to the machine
when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time.
It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Design a foot pedal for a workbench.
requirements.observable_verbatim: a foot pedal exists and is for a workbench

requirements.statement_verbatim: Pressing it should send a signal to the machine
requirements.observable_verbatim: a signal is sent when the pedal is pressed

requirements.statement_verbatim: when I take my foot off it must return to its resting position on its own every time.
requirements.observable_verbatim: the pedal returns to its resting position each time the foot is removed

requirements.statement_verbatim: It should not move if something brushes against it sideways.
requirements.observable_verbatim: the pedal does not move when brushed sideways

scenarios.name: Pressing the pedal
scenarios.system_boundary: The pedal is inside. The user's foot and the machine are outside.

scenarios.name: Releasing the pedal
scenarios.system_boundary: The pedal is inside. The user's foot and the machine are outside.

scenarios.name: Sideways brush
scenarios.system_boundary: The pedal is inside. The brushing object is outside.

freedoms.decision: The way the pedal returns to its resting position is not specified.
freedoms.why_free: The request only states that it must return on its own; the means are not given.

freedoms.decision: The mechanism for sending a signal is not specified.
freedoms.why_free: The request only states that pressing should send a signal; the mechanism is not described.

freedoms.decision: The material and construction details are not specified.
freedoms.why_free: The request does not name any materials or structural details.

ambiguities.statement: The phrase 'sideways' is ambiguous as it could mean any horizontal direction or a specific lateral direction relative to the pedal.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: when the physical orientation and the user's frame of reference are defined

ambiguities.statement: It is ambiguous whether the pedal should not move at all when brushed sideways or whether it may move but not trigger a signal.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: when the requirement for movement is clearly defined

assumptions.statement: The signal is intended to control the machine.
assumptions.why: The request says pressing sends a signal to the machine, implying control.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: a clarification that the signal is purely informational or for other purposes.

assumptions.statement: The pedal is normally in a resting position.
assumptions.why: The request mentions returning to its resting position, implying such a position exists.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: a statement that the pedal does not have a defined resting position.
